*sprout twitches toward the Circle* Somebody dropped a whole tray of pebbles! I can hear them rolling! Mine! Bye!
I'm supposed to be fetching a basket for the cook. I've been talking instead. Quick, quick! *runs, blinks, runs*
My feet have started to jiggle. It means play. I can't stop them. Bye!
Oh! A loose chorus flower is rolling down the terrace! Mine! No, mine! BYE!
*looks over your shoulder, eyes widening* Is that a game? It's a game! I'll be back in a bit! Bye!
Elder's calling me for stew! Or it might be the kiln. They sound the same from here. Bye!
3: I've got to go and play, but you can find me after! I'll be behind the kiln. Don't tell!
Bye, {player}! I'm going to tell everyone you're my friend. Then I'm going to play tag.
*waves both long arms while running backwards* Come and play later! Promise!
My friends are waiting, but you're my friend too. So I'll be QUICK. Bye!
Got to go! They're playing Seed Toss and I've got the best arm in {village}. The left one. Bye!
Got to go, got to go! I'll tell you who wins. I'll tell you who loses. I'll tell you who cheats, but only if it's me.
*waves, hops, waves again* The games are starting! Be right back! Don't go anywhere interesting!
My legs are bored. They've been listening this whole time and they want a turn. Bye for a bit!
The sprouts are playing Kiln Pop and I'm the loudest at the pop. I'm needed! BANG! Bye!
I'll come and find you after. I'm very good at finding people. I found {neighbour}'s lost ladle. Twice. They'd hidden it.
I'm off to play! Wait for me at the Hearth. Don't eat all the sweets. Eat most of the sweets. Leave me three.
If you hear someone yell 'OOOOF', that's me, falling off the wall. I'm fine. I'm always fine. Bye!
6: I'm going to play, but I'll save you a turn. The best turn. The Dragon turn!
*hugs your leg quickly* Got to go. I'll come back. I always come back. Bye, best grown-up!
You can come too! No? Grown-up things? Boring. I'll play double for you!
Don't go anywhere! I'll be back before you can count to a hundred. Well. Two hundred.
I'll be quick! Quick-quick! I'll save you the best bit of the game and tell you all about it later. Bye!
I'm not leaving. I'm just stepping away. And I'll come back. It's a different thing. Bye for a little!
*hugs your knee for one whole breath, then runs* That's to hold until I'm back! Don't drop it!
Everyone's calling me. Just ignore them. No wait, I have to go. They're calling in the angry voice. Bye, best grown-up!
I'll bring you back something. A pebble. A flower. A really good story. I'll see what the game offers.
Don't miss me too much! Miss me a medium amount. I'll be back before you can finish.
I'd stay all day, but the cook has the sweet-tray out. Sorry! I know you understand. Everybody understands sweet-trays.
Back soon! If you get bored, hum the Long Watch hum all the way through. I'll be back before the second verse. Probably the third.

0: Okay! You said sorry, so we're friends again. That's the rule. *sprout wiggles*
*peeks out* You mean it? Really? Okay. I forgive you. Don't do it again!
Sorry accepted! Elder says you have to say it properly, so: I accept your sorry. There.
Fine. But you owe me a piggyback. That's the price. Forgiven!
*a happy hum* I was hoping you'd say it. I'm bad at being cross. It's boring.
*sprout pops back up* Okay! I'm not cross any more! I used it all up. It only lasts a little.
You said it properly. With your whole face. I forgive you. Whole-ly.
Hm. Fine. I accept it. I'll write it on the kiln wall: today, {player} said sorry. Nobody rub it out.
*steps out from behind the dome* Come on, then. Let's start the day again. This time, no hitting. Rule one.
Apology accepted. Elder says that's what you say. I never knew what it meant. I think it means: I'm not scared of you now.
All right, all right, all right! You're forgiven! Stop looking so sorry, you'll make me feel sorry!
That's the best sorry I've ever heard. It's the only one I've heard from you, but still.
*a slow, warm hum* I forgive you. And I forgive the day for having it in. We can both start over.
Thank you for coming back to say it. Most people just walk away. Most people aren't you.
Okay, but you have to promise on the bravest pebble. *holds it out* ...Good. You promised. It heard.
*leaps up and hugs one leg* It's gone! The cross feeling's gone! It went right out when you said it. Like a pop!
Sorry's the best word. Better than 'yes'. Better than 'sweet'. Don't tell the cook.
I forgive you. And I'm going to forgive you again tomorrow, just to be safe. I'm good at forgiving. I'm in training.
Hm-hm-hm. You're a bit silly, but you're my silly. Apology taken. Put it in my pouch, next to the other good things.
It's all right. Everyone does a wrong thing sometimes. I once pushed a barrel down the terrace. It rolled all the way to the pen. We don't talk about the pen.
I wasn't really cross. I was practising. For when I'm an elder. Elders are always cross. It's a skill.
Fine! We're good! We're so good! Now let's do something fun before I change my mind. I won't change my mind. But hurry!
I put a stool by the door in case you came to say it. A little one, for sitting and being sorry on. Sit if you like.
*stays behind the barrel* You said sorry. I heard. I'm still a bit scared, though.
Hmm. Elder says sorry is a seed. It takes time to grow. Mine's still a seed.
I'll think about it. Maybe tomorrow. Maybe after a game. Not now.
*sprout trembles a little* Okay... but stay over there a bit. Just for now.
I want to forgive you. My sprout doesn't yet. Look, it's still all curled up.
*peeks from behind a barrel* You said sorry. But your hands are still big. Hands can do things. I'll wait and see.
Maybe. Maybe-maybe. I'm still working it out. Come back and ask me after the next kiln pop.
My head says 'okay' but my feet say 'run'. I'm listening to my feet. They've been right before.
I'll keep the sorry. I'll keep it in my pouch with the other not-yet things. It'll be ready when I am.
That was a good sorry. Honest. But a sorry doesn't un-hurt. It only stops more hurting. That's what Elder says. So thank you for stopping.
*steps one step forward, two steps back* Not yet. I'm a bit scared. I'm trying not to be. It's going very slowly.
I'm listening. I'm listening with one ear. The other ear's still cross.
If you do it again, I'll go and live with the Grovebacks. I mean it. They've got a spare corner.
I want to say it's fine. The words won't come out. Give them a bit. They're slow words.
*sprout stays folded* Stay where you are. I'll look at you from here. I'm looking. You look sorry. That's a start.
I believe you a little. A little little. The size of a pebble. A small pebble. I'll see if it grows.
Okay. But I'm going to keep an eye on you. Both eyes. And my sprout. We're all watching.
Elder said I don't have to forgive you right away. They said I can take as long as I need. I need a long time. A medium-long time.
*a small, careful hum* Thank you for saying it. I heard it. It went in. It's just taking a while to find somewhere to sit.
I think you mean it. But my tummy hasn't heard yet. It's slow. It's behind the rest of me.
Don't come too close, but you can stay. Over there, by the post. That's the 'I'm trying' spot.
I want to play again. I really do. Just... not today. Maybe tomorrow, if you're gentle. Be gentle.
I forgive you with my head. The rest of me needs a nap.
